name_reason: Convention-compliant (data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>): domain=chapter_intro_menu, descriptor=speaker_portrait_id_table. Accurately reflects content (a byte table of speaker portrait/DATO ids for the chapter-intro menu) and data type (table/id). No Ghidra address residue; no domain-ID suffix to preserve. Live Ghidra symbol byte-identical.
purpose: Per-chapter-intro-menu-variant greeting-speaker DATO.DAT portrait-sprite id, indexed by chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state (0..5) and passed to fd2_load_chapter_portrait to load/blit the greeting NPC portrait.
logic_summary: 6-byte const lookup. Each reader does fd2_load_chapter_portrait(table[chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state @ 0x5412B]) (typeB hardcodes index 0 since its state is always 0). fd2_load_chapter_portrait @ 0x1956b maps the value: 0x80..0x84 -> one of five fixed mode13h blit offsets (special story-NPC speaker positions), any other value -> default offset 0x9017; then it loads that sprite id from DATO.DAT via fd2_load_dat_resource("DATO.DAT", buf, value) and blits it into the dialog frame. Table values {0x81,0x80,0x00,0x82,0x83,0x84}: states 0,1,3,4,5 use special NPC portraits 0x80-0x84; state 2 = 0x00 is an ordinary character portrait id (and state 2 has no intro menu, so it is effectively a placeholder).
element_semantics: element[state] = DATO.DAT portrait-sprite id for the chapter-intro menu greeting speaker in chapter-transition/cursor state `state` (0..5). 0x80..0x84 select the five special story-NPC speaker portraits with fixed blit positions; other values are standard character portrait ids drawn at the default position.
comment_original_issue: Original comment was accurate but slightly imprecise: phrasing 'passed to fd2_load_chapter_portrait / fd2_load_dat_resource' could imply the table value is sometimes passed straight to fd2_load_dat_resource, whereas every reader passes it only to fd2_load_chapter_portrait (which internally loads it from DATO.DAT). Also did not note the 0x80..0x84-vs-ordinary-portrait-id value distinction nor that all shop sub-menus also read it.
notes: is_const confirmed: zero game-side write xrefs (all 20 xrefs are READ or DATA-load-effective-address reads from chapter-intro / shop menu functions). Readers verified: fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main (0x2e3d8/0x2e54d), fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeB (uses [0]), fd2_run_buy_item_menu (multiple sites). fd2_load_chapter_portrait @ 0x1956b confirms DATO.DAT load semantics and the 0x80-0x84 special-position mapping. Live Ghidra symbol name matches assigned name. Ghidra data plate at 0x52659 was empty -> created concise PLATE_COMMENT (src is source of truth).
